evidenceBasis: Completed bounded official-source review of historical production, with consolidation resolutions; not actual older-cluster integration.
currentSourceApplicability: Requires reassessment after production layout changes.

findings.change: OpenShift4.21 explicitly uses Kubernetes1.34; DRA alpha serving removals and new beta admission API
findings.assessment: Official About-this-release explicitly maps1.34. Removed resource.k8s.io/v1alpha3 types and v1alpha4 DRA gRPC do not occur in either inventory; automatic ResourceClaims/custom-scheduler migrations require manual review. New MutatingAdmissionPolicy beta is server admission infrastructure, not a converter configuration API.
findings.validationOrRequiredAction: Retain endpoint discovery and raw server admission; actual 4.21.36 results remain specific to the exact artifact.

findings.change: PodLevelResources beta/default, hugepage/default/HPA/downwardAPI behavior; in-place resize conditions
findings.assessment: Target Pod budgets are refused before typed conversion, including admission defaults. Other running Pods raw spec.resources requests CPU/memory/hugepages override per-resource aggregate then overhead, matching official v1.34.9 PodRequests. Container observed requests/allocatedResources maxima match feasible resizing. For infeasible resize current spec-max may overestimate safely. No separate Pod-level status budget is used by1.34 helper; no demonstrated undercount from this review.
findings.validationOrRequiredAction: Existing observed-allocation contracts + sidecar/overhead tests. Do not infer new Pod target features are supported just because external allocations are counted.

findings.change: PodSecurity baseline/restricted block probe/lifecycle host; usernamespace+volumeDevices invalid; SCC usernamespace policies
findings.assessment: Nonempty probe/lifecycle host values and hostUsers=false+volumeDevices are existing fields whose validation changed; actual raw Pod create dryrun returns rejection before source mutation. hostUsers is preserved and defaults true per linkedguidance; isolated namespaces need compatible UID/GID/filesystems. ActualSA defaulting/requiredSCC checks do not assume legacypolicy names. nested-container UID constraints corrected in4.21.25 are evaluated from current server policy.
findings.validationOrRequiredAction: Retain recheck-admission-before-retirement and SA authorization contracts. Could add representative probehost serverrejection fixture during consolidated regression if not covered.

findings.change: Container restart rules, EnvFiles/fileKeyRef, hostnameOverride; stricter supplemental groups inherited
findings.assessment: New container restartPolicy/restartPolicyRules, env FileKeyRef and Pod hostnameOverride are post-baseline fields, so unavailable typed knowledge cannot silently erase them. Native-sidecar restartPolicy/recursiveReadOnly/supplementalGroupsPolicy/seLinuxChangePolicy guards continue from earlier releases. Broader string enum validation is separate parent review; field presence alone is not an enum validator.
findings.validationOrRequiredAction: Keep representative raw input/SCC/Pod/create-response unknown-field contracts; parent will evaluate enum changes during SDK alignment.

findings.change: Default openshift ClusterImagePolicy active; signature mirroring issue in disconnected clusters; short-name pull fix
findings.assessment: Pod dryrun does not pull or prove signatures. Official known issue specifically concerns mirroring release images without Sigstore signatures and future CVO Pods, not a blanket statement that every arbitrary application image must have Red Hat signature. Workload image policy/trust/auth/mirror resolution must function on target nodes; unqualified image searches also have patch-dependent behavior. Converter preserves full image references and does not disable image policies.
findings.validationOrRequiredAction: Use immutable fully-qualified test images; explicitly validate required image signatures/credentials/mirrors before exclusive cutover. Startup failure tests/recovery do not prove everypossible imagepolicy.

findings.change: oVirt CSI Driver Operator removed; mutable CSI attach counts TP inOpenShift; resize/VolumeAttributesClass GA
findings.assessment: oVirt CSI operator removal is platform/driver availability, not removal of generic CSI Pod/PV API; do not block all CSI or assume old mounted volume proves a new mount. Users need a supported functioning driver. Tool does not write production claims/classes/snapshots/resize status or simulate dynamic CSI attach limits; regular CSI fixture cannot certify all vendor storage. RWO/RWX still recursive SELinux by default per linked 4.21 guidance; post-baseline namespace-injected seLinuxChangePolicy requires manual review.
findings.validationOrRequiredAction: Keep supported storage/data continuity and removed plugin refusal evidence; require external driver/attachment/mount review before exclusive cutover.

findings.change: RC terminatingReplica reconciliation and Deployment availableReplica timing fixes; long name fix; HPA API version validation
findings.assessment: Controller status/additional events are observational; actual owned Pod termination and Ready/health checks remain necessary. HPA retarget uses explicit apps/v1 Deployment API version; server dry run validates exact create body. Source DC updates are dynamic apps.openshift.io/v1 rather than upstream RC/scale calls. Repeated exactserver dry runs and actual responses cannot be replaced by status synthesis.
findings.validationOrRequiredAction: Keep long name/server validation/readiness/termination contracts where present; final exact-artifact live qualification remains parent work.

findings.change: Selector-aware authorization stable, authconfig/external tokensigners GA/Beta, VAP enforcement fixed forDC/BuildConfig
findings.assessment: SSAR supplies actualresource API version. Selector-restricted authorizers may conservatively refuse broad inventory review, never grant an actual operation. No converter server auth configuration/token claim parsing. OpenShift VAP fix can now deny DC freeze/retire; preflight dry runs each plannedDC spec and setSourceSpec repeats exact dry run immediately before the actual update.
findings.validationOrRequiredAction: Keep version-sensitive authorizer profiles, source admissionrefusal and interrupted/expired credential contracts; current API errors remain authoritative.

findings.change: EndpointSlices used by service proxy/kube-aggregator; legacy APF flow locks removed; topology spread matchLabelKeys merge
findings.assessment: corev1Endpoints remains served; change to aggregatedAPIServer manual Service Endpoints config is outside inventory. Singleton fixture already uses Lease not endpointsleases/configmapsleases and own CAS, so APF lock migration does not change format. Topologyspread matchLabelKeys is absentbaseline and hard DoNotSchedule spread is manual; no false claim of full scheduler preemption or CNI traffic simulation.
findings.validationOrRequiredAction: Keep actual endpoint UID/HTTP and Lease ownership observations. EndpointSlice migration remains a maintenance follow-up; dynamic network failures are not prevented by selector comparison.

findings.change: No Gt/Lt tolerationoperators inreviewed1.34corecontract; scheduling/NoExecutetiming changes
findings.assessment: Officialv1.34.9 coretypes lists only Exists/Equal. Newerclient0.37helper signature/optionalGtLt support postdates these target versions and is parent dependency work. CurrentNoExecutefinite expiry cannotprove durable placement and isnotaccepted; Node Ready/pressure/taints rechecked. Faster unreachable tainting isruntime availability, not permission to synthetically mark Ready.
findings.validationOrRequiredAction: Recommended parent future-proofing: preservebaseline enum guard when upgrading SDK, since baseline field presence alone does not validate enum values. This review does not invent 4.21 Gt/Lt support.

historicalSnapshots: Exact snapshots and source-bound resolution overlays require the external evidence bundle.
